ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is B in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the figure is a cross-sectional structure of a hoof, labeled with the letters B and D. The guide line for B points to the outermost, thicker, dotted-textured ring-like structure on the right cross-section, that is, the hard wall-like part on the outside of the hoof. Reasoning: The question asks what B in the figure is. According to hoof anatomical terminology, this hard, keratinized outer covering structure on the outside of the hoof is called horny hoof. Therefore, B is horny hoof.
